name: Indeed-UI-8B
notes: The ModelScope repository holds four safetensors shards in the Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration architecture with tokenizer, chat-template and processor configs. The card names no license.
summary: GUI grounding model fine-tuned from GUI-Owl 1.5-8B with grounding data and high-resolution training; the card reports 73.4 on ScreenSpot-Pro, 94.4 on ScreenSpot-V2 and 68.3 on OSWorld-G.
